home.modeMapInfo: Cleans specific zones defined on the map.
home.modeHouseInfo: Cleans the entire area it can, ignoring zones and no-go lines.
home.modeSpotInfo: Cleans a specific area defined by height and width.
home.mapModeHint: Map cleaning mode is available when robot is docked.

runs.noRuns: Your robot has not worked yet, make it sweat!

schedule.noSchedules: You don't have any schedules yet, why not add one?
schedule.selectZonesHelp: Optional, select one or more zones to clean, if none selected, it will clean entire map.
schedule.selectSingleZoneHelp: Optional: select one zone to clean. Click the selected zone again to clear it and clean the entire map.
schedule.requiredFields: Choose a day and a valid time before saving.
schedule.loadError: Could not load the schedule. Please try again.
schedule.updateError: Could not update the schedule. Your changes have not been confirmed; please try again.
schedule.refreshError: The command was accepted, but the updated schedule could not be confirmed. Reload before making more changes.

map.noMaps: You don't have any explored maps yet, start an exploration to draw boundaries!
map.gen4SelectMapGuide: After you have done an exploration, go to the history tab, select your run and mark map as floorplan!
map.cannotExploreNewMap: Robot needs to be docked to start exploration.
map.polygonHint: To make a no-go line, don't press the button to close the polygon.
map.lineHint: To make a zone, move the cursor to the first point and click the zone button (the one on the right); this connects the points and makes a zone.
map.drawHint: Drawing a line makes a no-go line; using the polygon button to connect the cursor with the first point makes a zone.
map.gen4UpdateBugHint: NOTE: modifying maps, zones, or lines may disable affected schedules. This is something that happens on the robot firmware, and we are looking into a workaround

settings.factoryResetInfo: (You will be asked to confirm) Restore your robot to its factory settings.
settings.comingSoon: Lots more coming soon - stay tuned!

serverUnreachable.title: Could not connect to the server
serverUnreachable.subtitle: The app could not connect to the Vacuula server! Please make sure the server is running and reachable from this device.
serverUnreachable.mdnsDisclaimer: If you are using mDNS (viewing site via vacuula.local), then it may take some time for the device to load the ip of the server, if the issue persists, try restarting the browser.
